headline: JadePuffer ransomware group hijacks Azure identities, destroys data
summary: The JadePuffer ransomware group is targeting Microsoft Azure tenants with agent-driven attacks that conduct reconnaissance, steal credentials and destroy core cloud components, hijacking Azure identities in the process. Microsoft has warned the activity resembles more agentic ransomware.

claims.statement: The JadePuffer ransomware group is using agent-driven attacks to target Azure, hijacking identities to destroy cloud resources.

sources.quote: The JadePuffer ransomware operator is targeting Azure tenants with agent-driven attacks that conduct reconnaissance, steal credentials, and destroy core components.
JadePuffer crims hijacked Azure identities and used them to blow up cloud resources

claims.statement: Microsoft has warned this looks like more agentic ransomware activity.

sources.quote: Smells like more agentic ransomware, Redmond warns
